about: Single-quoted play-flow messages that were above grade 2 (or used a system word) when the 13.2 extractor was fixed to read strings containing the letter n (open-release audit S8, 2026-11-14). The test fails on any new failing string; rewriting one of these removes it from the debt. Do not add to this list.
